* org-info-src.js
- References
  - [[https://orgmode.org/manual/JavaScript-support.html][JavaScript Support]]
  - [[https://orgmode.org/worg/code/org-info-js/][EMACS ORG-INFO.JS]] 

Allows the web page to be viewed similar to how they look in emacs for me.
I use the un-minimized version of the script.
  
- Possible GOTCHA:  I use html5 export and code is written for XHTML export.
  So far I don't see any issues.
- Downloaded as org-info-src.js from [[https://orgmode.org/worg/code/org-info-js/org-info-src.js][WORG Org-Mode site]] on 2025-03-04
  - Local copy: [[file:org-info-src.js][org-info-src.js]]
- org-info-src.js.license

  Add license file since downloaded file uses invalid SPDX identifier.

  Date of 2008-2009 based on [[https://github.com/RickMoynihan/org-info-js/commits/master/org-info.js?after=838a90160291d4ee81be99a92f04b31d33e523f2+34][git history]] in Rick Moynihan's forked copy
  of Sebastian's now inaccessible repository.
  
  # REUSE-IgnoreStart
  #+NAME: org-info-src.js.license
  #+HEADER: :tangle "org-info-src.js.license"
  #+begin_src text
    SPDX-License-Identifier:  GPL-3.0-or-later
    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2008-2009 Sebastian Rose, Hannover, Germany - sebastian_rose at gmx dot de
  #+end_src
  # REUSE-IgnoreEnd
